name: neon-bloom
note: The edge preset's post: heavy bloom with a wide saturated halo round every lit edge, the filmic tonemap keeping saturated edges coloured, a vignette into the void, fine grain and lens dirt, and a void toe sinking the lit world toward black (neon-look-style.md, Post); calm since ps-wnj.24: bloom and halo at 70%, the beat a third, the full flash for special moments and a calm moment's at 30% of it (neon-look-style.md, Restraint). The halo flares to 2.5x its own on a special moment's first frame (halo.special, ps-wnj.19).
